description: License entitlement: vendor, title, purchased count, license model (per-user, per-device, concurrent, site, subscription), term, renewal date, governing contract. The legal right-to-use, distinct from actual installations.

Canonical software product in the catalog (e.g. a creative suite, productivity suite, CAD application, IDE). Carries vendor, edition, family, version range. Distinct from installations (which reference a title) and from licenses (which entitle a count of users to a title).
Connection metadata to upstream systems: auth mechanism, sync schedule, incremental-capture state, connector plugin type.
Raw record from a source system before match/merge processing; preserves provenance and source identifier for lineage.

Git repository hosted on the VSDP platform: name, default branch, visibility (public / internal / private), language, owner, last-activity. Distinct from KMS knowledge artifacts and DAM digital_assets.
OMS routing logic output: which warehouse will fulfill which line, with rationale (lowest_cost / fastest_ship / fulfills_split / 3pl_preference / exception_override) and confidence_score.

RFx process record: RFI, RFQ, RFP, or reverse auction. Carries scope, supplier list, scorecard / weighting, responses, and the awarded supplier. The pre-contract stage that produces a sourcing decision feeding CLM.
Analytics on actual office occupancy/usage: peak-hour patterns, underutilization zones, utilization rates. Drives real-estate optimization. Distinct from REAL-EST `occupancy_records` (operational).
Stockroom counts and procurement of replacement hardware components (not yet deployed assets).
Pre-spend authorization rules (card limits, vendor restrictions, approval matrices) — distinct from EXPENSE post-hoc policies.

Pre-spend approval request raised by an employee before a purchase, for a virtual card, raised card limit, vendor bill, or reimbursement budget. Modern spend-management platforms anchor on this proactive request workflow as the entry point before any transaction occurs. Lifecycle: draft -> submitted -> approved/declined -> spent (linked to one or more card_transactions / payment_runs).
Investor commitment to an SPV: simpler than fund-level lp_subscriptions; typically smaller LP base, single capital call at close.
Special Purpose Vehicle — single-deal investment vehicle (LLC-typed) with limited LP base. Dominant vehicle below ~$25M deal size.
Visual representation of building floors and suites showing current occupants, lease-expiration dates, vacant suites, and combinability options; the working tool of CRE leasing.
Agency or managed-service provider relationship with tiered preference, performance scorecard, master service agreement, and certified-recruiter roster.
Autoclave/steam-sterilization records for reusable surgical instruments: cycle parameters (time, temp, pressure), batch ID, QA certification. Validates sterile-field integrity pre-procedure.
A land or trailer storage space for a vessel kept ashore: location, size, and assigned vessel.
Daily/shift store operational checklist (open / close / safety / cleanliness / loss-prevention). Template-driven execution and sign-off records.
In-store compliance/operational audit (health/safety, merchandising, inventory accuracy, point-of-sale). Distinct from enterprise AUDIT (`audit_plans` / `audit_findings`).
B2C-COMM order subcase where fulfillment = store pickup. OMS masters store-assignment and hold-time orchestration: allocated_store_id, hold_window_start/end, pickup_status.

Task assigned to retail associates (shelf stocking, planogram execution, zone cleaning, till reconciliation, safety checks). Core unit of store-level workforce execution and accountability. Scope-qualified vs onboarding_tasks, project_tasks.
The mapping between a listing and an external booking channel or OTA, with sync status for rates and availability.
A message in the unified guest inbox tied to a reservation, inbound or outbound across any channel.
A guest profile: contact details, identity/verification status, and stay history across reservations.
A cleaning or turnover task scheduled against a listing, typically fired by a checkout, assigned to a cleaner or team.
A rental unit as marketed and published to booking channels: address, amenities, capacity, house rules, photos, and availability.
A record of occupancy/lodging tax collected on a reservation and its filing and remittance to the taxing jurisdiction.
A periodic trust-accounting statement for a property owner: booking revenue, commissions, pass-through expenses, and the net payout.
A local short-term-rental registration or permit for a listing: permit number, jurisdiction, issue and expiry dates, and status.
An owner whose properties a manager operates: contact details, management agreement, commission terms, and payout details.
Pricing configuration for a listing: base and seasonal rates, dynamic-pricing rules, fees, and min/max-stay constraints.
A guest stay booked against a listing: dates, channel of origin, party size, pricing, and payment and check-in/out status.
A review left after a stay, by a guest about a listing or by a host about a guest, synced across channels.
Multi-quarter / annual program aligned to corporate strategy; bundles related projects, has executive sponsor and benefits realization plan.
Container for strategic initiatives grouped by business unit, product line, or cost center; aggregate KPIs and investment rules.

Decisions captured during operating reviews or strategy off-sites: changes to objective priorities, resource reallocation, initiative go/no-go, scope adjustments. Single decision-maker per record; once decided, the record is locked except by explicit revert.

Balanced-scorecard and strategy-house visualizations linking strategic pillars to objectives, initiatives, and measures across financial, customer, process, and learning perspectives. Configured once per planning horizon; rarely changes structure.
GDPR Article 15 subject-access-request ticket: requester, scope, fulfillment status, regulator deadline.
Sublease grant / consent / commencement / termination with its own financial lifecycle vs the head lease.
Insurer pursuit of recovery from a liable third party: claim reference, third party, coverage class, demand amount, status, recovery amount, date range. Reduces net loss after a claim is paid.
Executed legal subscription package for an LP subscription: the signed agreement, side documents, and version history that persists across amended subscriptions.
Bench plan for a critical position: identified successors, readiness ratings (ready_now, 1-2_years, 3+_years), development plans, risk-of-loss assessment.
Supplier-issued certification document (GFSI, organic, kosher, halal, allergen statement, insurance COI) with expiry tracking.
Vendor ESG performance profile: questionnaire responses, audit results, certifications (ISO 14001, B-Corp), Scope 3 estimate. Annual refresh.
Single resolved supplier identity across all source systems (S2P/SUP-LIFE), resolved via match/merge/survivorship.

Supplier-issued invoice for goods or services delivered. AP runs 3-way match (PO + receipt + invoice) before approving for payment. Multi-domain consumption: EXPENSE consumes when a corporate card path overlaps, FINOPS consumes the cloud-invoice slice for cost allocation.
Onboarding workflow instance for a new supplier: invitation, registration form, document collection (W-9, banking, insurance, compliance attestations), approval chain.
Risk and compliance profile for an active supplier: sanctions screening, financial-health rating, ESG scoring, ISO/SOC certifications, cyber-risk assessment. Periodically reassessed.
Operational / financial / cyber risk-scoring record per supplier; feeds GRC consumption.
KPI-weighted performance rating of a supplier over a period: on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, savings delivered. Drives tier preference in sourcing decisions.
Vendor master record: legal name, tax id, addresses, payment terms, contacts, currency, statuses, risk profile. The supplier-side analog to the customer master.

A contact-center interaction record (voice call, chat session, video session, callback). Captures session metadata: duration, channel, agent, customer, resolution status. Distinct from CSM's customer_cases (the support case is the business artifact; the support_session is the engagement event that may or may not result in a case).
Listening cadence definition: annual engagement, pulse, lifecycle (onboarding, 30/60/90-day, exit), 360-feedback. Carries audience, question set, frequency, anonymity floor.
Individual employee response to a survey_campaign instance. Aggregated under anonymity thresholds to engagement_drivers; never exposed at individual level to managers below floor.

Proactive end-to-end test against a SaaS app from a geo/network location: request/response payload, HTTP status, latency, SSL validity, geo tag, schedule reference. Network-outside-in probes (vs OBS instrumented internals).
Group session where managers normalize ratings across populations to remove rater bias and fit forced-distribution constraints. Produces calibrated performance_reviews outcomes.
Junction between candidates and talent_pools. Carries added timestamp, source, status_in_pool (cold/warm/hot), match score, and last_engagement timestamp.
Curated segment or pipeline of candidates kept warm for future roles (e.g. silver medallists, alumni, target-school grads, hard-to-fill skill clusters).

Rule-based pool definition (boolean filter over candidates) that materializes membership automatically. Examples: 'Senior PMs in NYC with FinTech experience', 'Engineering alumni who left in the last 2 years'.
A named, approved list of accounts to pursue in the plan period; the handoff artifact to CRM and the ABM platform.

Federal, state, provincial, or local taxing jurisdiction with rate tables, deposit schedules, and reporting forms. Includes US IRS/state/locals, UK HMRC, German Finanzamt, French URSSAF, Australian ATO.
Periodic statutory submission to a tax authority (US 941/W-2, UK FPS/EPS, German DEUEV/Lohnsteueranmeldung, French DSN, Australian STP). Includes payment and reporting; failure carries penalties.

Tax-return record managed by a preparer: tax year, return type (1040, 1120, 1065, etc.), client, status (in-prep, review, ready-for-signature, filed, accepted, rejected), filing method, refund/balance-due.
Crawl-based SEO issue: meta robots block, missing canonical, duplicate content, page-speed bottleneck, sitemap misconfiguration, structured-data error. Distinct from keyword/topical SEO (MA-owned).
Evaluation of an application's tech-stack alignment with enterprise standards and vendor roadmap; score + gap analysis + remediation roadmap.
Vendor platform / tech stack with version, EOL, upgrade status, org-wide instance count. Distinct from `vendors` (legal entity) and `solutions` (product).
Subscriber bill — multi-rated usage + subscription + tax lines, billing-period summary, payment status. Distinct from S2P invoices, SUB-MGMT `customer_invoices`, and rent_payments.
Commercial service offerings with technical specifications, rate plans, and SLA terms; TM Forum eTOM catalog master. Distinct from internal IT service catalogs and SaaS pricing catalogs.

Service provisioning order (activate / modify / suspend / deactivate). Carries customer, service catalog reference, requested date, status, fulfillment workflow reference. Distinct from B2C-COMM `orders` (commerce) and SUB-MGMT customer-subscription change orders.

Active service instance per subscriber (mobile line, fiber connection, leased circuit): carrier-customer relationship with the operational service. Distinct from SUB-MGMT `customer_subscriptions` (SaaS seller-side).
Commercial-tenant financial health, payment history, default risk; underwrites CRE leasing decisions.

Tenant-submitted issue tracked from intake through vendor dispatch to resolution; carries photos, urgency, communication thread. Distinct from FM/EAM work orders in that the requester is a paying tenant, not an internal employee.
A carved sales territory: the accounts and geography assigned to a rep or team.
Reusable test definition (manual or automated reference): preconditions, steps, expected results, tags, traceability to requirements and test suites.
Defect discovered during testing; distinct from ITSM incidents. Carries reproduction steps, environment context, severity, priority, assigned developer, status, root cause.
Configured environment (OS variant, browser, device, SaaS tenant version, DB state) where test execution occurs. Enables matrix testing and environment-specific failure traceability.
Master planning document scoping test coverage, timeline, resources, environment assignments, entry/exit criteria for a release or phase.
Single execution instance of a test_case or suite against a target environment: outcome (pass / fail / blocked / skipped), duration, environment context, tester, failure logs.
Grouping of test_cases by feature/release/type. Enables batch execution, cross-browser/environment matrix, organized reporting.
Recorded clock-in / clock-out / break event from a time-collection device, mobile app, or manual entry. Approved time entries are the WFM↔PAYROLL handoff payload.

Accrual / entitlement rule definition for a leave type: by country, role, tenure tier, with caps, carry-over, and conversion rules. Country-specific by statute (US PTO, UK statutory leave, German Urlaub, French Congés Payés).
A configured integration to an external delivery tool from which work items and events are mirrored into the value-stream model.
Scheduled property showings with lock-box codes, access windows, agent attendance, and follow-up tracking.
Lot / batch identifier per FSMA-204 Traceability Lot Code (TLC); links upstream sources to downstream consignees.
Labeled document samples used to train or fine-tune IDP extraction models. Carries document_type, sample_count, labeling completion, training window, lineage to trained models.
Inspection-ready evidence package: signed roster, certificate hash, content version, signature record reference. Generated for regulator submission.
Reservation of a physical or virtual room and resources for an instructor-led session.
In-flight data transformation logic: mappings, UDFs, validation rules, masking policies. May delegate to external compute or SQL engines.
Imported itinerary from a travel-booking partner: air, hotel, ground. Pre-trip approval and post-trip expense reconciliation.

The configured set of rules that govern what travelers may book: fare classes, advance-purchase windows, preferred suppliers, spend caps, and out-of-policy handling. Drives policy-aware shopping and approval routing.

The per-traveler record holding seat and meal preferences, loyalty and frequent-traveler memberships, travel documents (passport, visa, known-traveler numbers), and emergency contacts that personalize shopping and satisfy identity and duty-of-care requirements.

A pre-trip authorization request and its decision, routed when a trip is out of policy, over a cost threshold, or bound for a high-risk destination, capturing the approver, the decision, and any exception justification.

A single reservation at the reservation-record level: a flight, hotel stay, rail journey, or car rental with its confirmation, fare or rate, ancillaries, and ticketing status. The bookable unit a segment is created from.
The ordered set of travel segments (air, hotel, rail, car, ground) for a trip, assembled from individual reservations and kept synchronized as segments are added, changed, or disrupted.

A returned set of bookable options for a shopping request, aggregated from GDS, NDC, and direct-supplier content and ranked against travel policy. Derived from a search query against live inventory; the basis from which a booking is made.

IOLTA-style trust-account ledger: per-client and per-matter balances, three-way-reconciliation evidence, state-specific retention. Distinct from operating accounts; commingling is an ethics violation.
Residual value from an unused or partially used ticket that can be reapplied to a future booking, tracked through its available, reapplied, and expired states so prepaid value is recovered.
Metered-billing inputs — events / consumption units / overage credits feeding usage-based pricing tiers. Stream from product instrumentation (or B2C-COMM events) into SUB-MGMT for cycle aggregation.
